additions.name: Haoyang Langfang No. 1 Existing Operations

status.summary: Dated television report identifies the named campus operations manager describing implemented service and equipment controls sustaining stable operation; contemporaneous reporter observations show running servers. August 13 is publication confirmation, not an exact visit or opening day.

locator.precision: Approximate analyst-selected parent-campus marker between the two data-center blocks, rounded to four decimals. It is not an operator-published pin, surveyed centroid, parcel boundary, individual building footprint or phase location.
locator.identity_review: Operator history explicitly bridges the former Guan Fuai Electronics project to Langfang No. 1; CQC certifies No.27 Dongfang Street. The operator plan and rendering match two side-by-side data-center blocks, southwest substation, southeast support building and east/south roads in the georeferenced image. Root independently reviewed these images and replayed the eight-control affine calculation.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Historic low-resolution plan, manual control selection, roof displacement/parallax and unknown imagery geolocation/date leave absolute positional accuracy unbounded. Internal fit residuals are not ground accuracy; no status is inferred from imagery.

additions.distinctness_review: All 408 sites,433 projects and231 preserved source records checked for Haoyang, Hao Yang, Fuai, Zhi Sheng and Chinese aliases; no existing identity match. Nearest existing campus is Boda Langfang No.2 about34.7km away. Haoyang No.2 is a separate proposed campus and is excluded; no separate A/B count.
additions.successor_review: October12 Hebei Daily report repeats No.1 operating observations but its exact dated No.1 participant operating assertion is not established, so status_as_of remains the August13 manager report. October No.2 civil work narrative, ongoing equipment deliveries and January2023 first customer history do not change this existing-operations scope.
